etymology: a prolonged form of a primary _*yew*_ theo theh'-o (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses)
avSummary: lay 28, put 18, lay down 12, make 10, appoint 6, kneel down + 1119 + 3588 5, misc 17
definition:
1) to set, put, place
    1a) to place or lay
    1b) to put down, lay down
        1b1) to bend down
        1b2) to lay off or aside, to wear or carry no longer
        1b3) to lay by, lay aside money
    1c) to set on (serve) something to eat or drink
    1d) to set forth, something to be explained by discourse
 2) to make
    2a) to make (or set) for one's self or for one's use
 3) to set, fix establish
    3a) to set forth
    3b) to establish, ordain
